description: Check whether a serverless endpoint is actually serving: readiness, workers, and recent error state. Use when inference is failing or slow, or before sending a job to an endpoint created a moment ago — a configured endpoint is not a ready one, and this is the difference between them. Prefer it to reading the endpoint record, which reports what was asked for rather than what is running. Read-only and free.
name: get_serverless_endpoint_health
